name: vscodeunrealutils
description: Configures Unreal Engine C++ projects to work with clangd IntelliSense.

commands.title: Unreal Utils: Setup Project for Clangd

unreal-utils.unrealBuildToolPath.description: Path to UnrealBuildTool executable (e.g. UnrealBuildTool.exe on Windows, or Build.bat). If empty, the extension will attempt to auto-resolve it from tasks.json or the registry.

unreal-utils.targetName.description: Target Name for compilation database (e.g., MyGameEditor). If empty, auto-detects from the uproject name.

unreal-utils.buildConfiguration.description: Build configuration to use when generating the compilation database.

unreal-utils.buildPlatform.description: Target platform to use when generating the compilation database.

unreal-utils.autoRunOnStartup.description: Automatically run setup on startup if compile_commands.json or .clangd is missing in an Unreal project.

unreal-utils.useNoExecCodeGenActions.description: Add -NoExecCodeGenActions to the UBT command to speed up database generation (recommended for UE 5.3+).
